column1: # Chapter 3 — Pandemonium arena: Zero-route exchange and Zephal's ambush.

column2: Tch! You lucky bastards... You have cost me dearly...
But your luck runs out here!! Your next opponent is the strongest man in history, with fifty straight wins in this arena...
Even if the lot of you come at him together... you will be no match for him!!
But surely you do not mean to stop the match now, after coming this far...?!
That is good to hear... I have already wagered my entire fortune on your losing!!
I watched your last match... It seems your skills have not dulled yet!
But why...?
Why are you trying to repeat the same mistake...?
It seems that this time too...
you hesitated to repeat the same mistake...
I told you plainly that day...
Never bring women onto a battlefield...
And yet why do you!!
Why do you drive women into battle...?!
How rude!!
We women are more than capable of fighting too!!
I do not mean that women are inferior to men...
But no matter how strong a woman may be in $$この世$$...
against a man who has trained just as hard, and been trained solely for battle...
she simply cannot match his physical strength. That is all I mean...
Conversely, no matter how hard a man tries...
he cannot fulfill the important role of bearing children...
No matter how he struggles...
even if he walks around on his hands!!
I only mean that men and women each have different roles given to them by the gods...
That is all.
Yet whenever you fight me...
you always bring women onto the battlefield!
Even though you know their bodies, given to them by the gods...
were never made for battle...
In the end, what can men do...?
At best, scatter their $$子種$$...
or find food for themselves and their families...
For a man, the most important thing...
is to protect what must be protected,
and spend his life fighting on the battlefield for it!!
That is why men are born in greater numbers than women...
why their $$出生比率$$ is higher, so they may die fighting outsiders at any time!!
That is...
the natural order, is it not...?!
Still, once someone stands on a battlefield, I treat women as men as well...
To hold back...
would be an insult to an opponent who comes at me.
Here I come!!
Well, well, well... The duck has brought its leek—and even carried along the pot!!
But why...?
Why do you all repeat the same mistake over and over...?
It seems that this time too...
you hesitated to repeat the same mistake...
Let me ask you lot something...
Why have you added...
women to your battle party?!
I told you before...
For most animals, the female's role is...
to bear children, raise them, and protect the home!!
And yet why do you!!
Why do you take them onto the battlefield...?!
How rude!!
We women are more than capable of fighting too!!
Do not misunderstand me.
I do not mean females are inferior to males...
But no matter how physically strong a female may be in $$この世$$...
against a male who has trained just as hard, and been trained solely for battle...
she cannot possibly match his strength!!
Conversely, no matter how hard a male tries...
he cannot fulfill the important role of bearing children...
I only mean that nature assigns roles that way...
That is all.
And when you use women to bait white-$$羽$$ men into a trap...
they trust you carelessly and fall for it every time!
Kill them!!
What the hell are you doing?!
Heh-heh-heh...
Heh-heh-heh...
I heard that you managed to $$脱獄$$...
So I planted some $$不発弾$$s beforehand in places that would catch your interest!!
How does it feel to fall for the same trick twice, $$レブロブス$$...?
I warned you before that women are monsters, did I not?!
Y-you... were a woman?!
Now then, shall we finally begin the battle...?!
